title: The Effects of Body Scan on Enteroception in Patients With Heart Failure
official: The Effects of Body Scan on Enteroception in Patients With Heart Failure: a Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: The study aims to explore the effects of body scan on enteroception in people with heart failure
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with Heart Failure
* Italian speaking
* Willing to sign the Informed Consent Form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cognitive Impairment documented in the medical records
